summary_1line: After praising Krishna, Yudhishthira dismisses the court, assigns conquered Kaurava palaces to his brothers, restores order, and honors allies and elders.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands in the royal court with folded hands praising Krishna, who shines in yellow silk with the Kaustubha gem on his chest.
Krishna, blue as a rain cloud, sits on a gem-studded golden couch while Yudhishthira approaches respectfully with joined palms.
The Pandava brothers enter the opulent Kaurava palaces now assigned to them, halls glittering with gold, gems, and attendants.
